# tr

Translate, delete or squeeze input bytes through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
printf 'hello\n' | moonx cli/tr 'a-z' 'A-Z'

printf 'a  b\n' | moonx cli/tr -s ' '
```

Read stdin and write stdout. Sets support ranges, byte escapes and C-locale character classes.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-d`, `--delete` | Delete SET1 bytes. |
| `-s`, `--squeeze-repeats` | Collapse repeated selected bytes. |
| `-c`, `--complement` | Complement SET1. |
| `-C` | Complement the first set. |
| `-t`, `--truncate-set1` | Truncate SET1 to SET2's length. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Notes

Workspace builds use the MoonBit 2026-11-26 toolchain.

- Operations are byte-oriented, without Unicode case conversion or multibyte character classes.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
